native_review.summary: The conversation proceeded successfully overall: the user was authenticated via name and zip code, the correct pending order (#W5270061) was identified, and both the shipping address update and the backpack item modification (with PayPal payment of the price difference) were completed after the user gave explicit confirmation. The user followed the simulation instructions correctly, including initially choosing a gift card for the price difference and then changing to PayPal and only modifying the backpack before final confirmation. The only errors were by the agent, who repeatedly violated procedural policy by making multiple tool calls in a single turn (turns 10 and 17) and by sending user-facing messages while simultaneously making tool calls (turns 6, 28, and 30). These violations were minor and did not affect the final outcome.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a user-facing message ('Thank you, Ivan! I found your account. Let me pull up your details...') and simultaneously made a tool call (get_user_details), violating the policy that the agent must not respond to the user and make a tool call at the same time.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the tool call without sending a user message, and only spoken to the user after receiving the tool response.

errors.reasoning: The agent made four get_order_details tool calls in a single turn and also sent a user-facing message, violating the policy requiring at most one tool call at a time and prohibiting simultaneous tool calls and user messages.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made one tool call per turn, waited for each response, and not combined a user message with a tool call.

errors.reasoning: The agent made two get_product_details tool calls in a single turn along with a user-facing message, again violating the one-tool-call-at-a-time and no-message-with-tool-call rules.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made one product details call at a time, awaited the response, and avoided sending a user message in the same turn as a tool call.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a user-facing message ('Thank you for confirming, Ivan! I'll proceed with the changes...') and made the modify_pending_order_address tool call in the same turn, violating the policy that tool calls and user responses must not occur simultaneously.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the address modification tool call without sending a user message, then reported the result after the tool response.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a user-facing message ('The shipping address has been updated... Now let me modify the backpack item') and made the modify_pending_order_items tool call in the same turn, violating the policy that tool calls and user messages must not occur simultaneously.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the item modification tool call without a simultaneous user message and then informed the user after receiving the tool response.
